message.skyabyss.tower.not_yet: Something seems to stand in the plaza. ...You can't see it yet.
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.hello: The tower desk. At the end of the bridge between sky and abyss, a colossal master waits. Challenge it as a squad. One entry per person per day.
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.used: You already entered the tower today. It rearranges at 5 a.m.
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.cannot_join: You can't join that squad (only by the desk, and only if you haven't entered today).
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.left_behind: You weren't by the desk, so you didn't enter this time.
message.skyabyss.tower.full: The tower is crowded right now. Wait a little.
message.skyabyss.tower.wipe: No one is left standing on the bridge. The tower pushes the squad back. ...That is all for today.
message.skyabyss.tower.woke: You woke in the rest area at the bridge entrance.
message.skyabyss.tower.title: The Tower Between
message.skyabyss.tower.sub: The bridge between sky and abyss — squad of %s
message.skyabyss.tower.fell: You nearly fell from the bridge and were pulled back to the entrance.
message.skyabyss.tower.timeout: Time ran out. The master chants the rewinding and the bridge unravels into white. ...That is all for today.
message.skyabyss.tower.intro: On the throne past the bridge, something vast raises its head... The One Seated Between. Reach the north plaza to strike its body.
message.skyabyss.tower.swarm: A swarm of sky and abyss pours onto the bridge. Binders who heal the master stand on the side platforms. Kill them first.
message.skyabyss.tower.stoke: The pull grows. The halo turns red; the master's attacks grow stronger and faster.
message.skyabyss.tower.moon: The master calls a falling moon. It crosses the bridge southward: break it before it reaches the south end. While it lives, the master cannot be hurt.
message.skyabyss.tower.moon_gone: The falling moon shatters. The master can be hurt again.
message.skyabyss.tower.moon_lost: The falling moon crossed the bridge. The world rewinds in white... Today's attempt ends here.
message.skyabyss.tower.arrows: Three heavenly arrows mark %s. Spread for the first; gather for the second and third.
message.skyabyss.tower.sigil: A red ring is chasing you. Keep running in circles.
message.skyabyss.tower.exhort: The repelling voice. You were close to the master: pushed back, mana drained.
message.skyabyss.tower.phlegm: Struck by a chain child: healing is weaker for a while.
message.skyabyss.tower.cleared: The One Seated Between collapses. You have crossed the tower. (%s)
message.skyabyss.tower.clear_back: You will return to the capital desk shortly.
